message: Board and officers to be confirmed by CIIHF. Names will be listed here once the federation supplies the current slate.
publicFacts: Registered as Cayman Islands Inline Hockey Federation Ltd., an active sporting organisation with the Cayman Islands General Registry.
Listed in the Cayman Islands Department of Sports directory.
Cayman Islands Federation affiliation with World Skate / FIRS was ratified at the 2017 Extraordinary Congress in Nanjing.
